tasks.label: Pull Latest TNYX
args:
set -euo pipefail
expected='feat/phase1-1-expo-shell-20261114'
current="$(git branch --show-current)"
if [ "$current" != "$expected" ]; then
  printf 'Stopped: current branch is %s, expected %s. Switch to the PR branch first.\n' "$current" "$expected"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  printf 'Stopped: local changes exist. Commit or safely stash them first.\n'
  git status --short
  exit 1
fi
git pull --ff-only origin "$expected"
printf 'TNYX updated to commit: '
git rev-parse --short HEAD
